_about: The play bot's seeded bugs (run.sh --selftest): each one a ref (or a ref + a patch under seeded/) the bot must catch, by the finding named in `expect` (a field that starts and ends with / is a regex). A bug it misses means the bot is broken, not the game fixed. The first three are the phone bugs of 2026-11-04/05 at the commit before their fixes; the fourth (a win with no 所得 — on the phone it was the native screen) is put back on the page by a patch; the hand's floor (hand-too-small) is squeezed by one and kept by its control. An entry with `absent: true` is a control (the same play with the bug not there must NOT raise the finding).

bugs.note: Hanli 11-04: 狼 kept at 上山路 — the 饭桶 from the 储物袋 refused a bare 「斗法未完」 (fixed e20846c1)
Hanli 11-05: six cards fanned so deep the cost gems sat on each other (fixed 4b14bd09)

Hanli 11-04: 痒痒针 spent 灵力 on an empty rank — the bug is a rank spell (痒痒针's sweep, 震怒's the same) taking 灵力 with nothing on the rank; either card caught counts. Four random hands, cards untried on an empty rank played first
Hanli 11-04: a win showed no 所得 (phone native). The patch puts it on the page: the 所得 card never drawn, and his blows land for 999 so the first fight is surely won
The page's own 11-05 bug, found by the bot: a won 降妖 and the scene's next board dealt over the stage at once, 所得 never shown (fixed dcab26ad). The patch only makes the win sure.
The control: the same sure win after the fix — 所得 shows, the check stays quiet.

Gate 11-07 at 375: the 杀招 line, both ranks full and the 丹 row at once squeezed the wheel's centre card to 65×90 — 青光's name cut, its words under 气血已满 (fixed 94b26505). The patch pins the hand at 130 px, so every fight's centre card is ~82 px tall
The control: the same fight at the fix, no patch — the centre card stands at its floor (128 px), the check stays quiet.
